patch.summary: HyNote cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: HyNote pricing is plan-gated across 5 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. 7-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: HyNote cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price HyNote against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (enterprise admin and SSO (Free, Pro, Plus, Unlimited, Teams)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (LLM chat and assistants, writing and paraphrasing, presentation generation) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: No meeting bot auto-join — capture is device recording or file upload (polarising vs Fireflies bot UX). Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Individuals and students who need multimodal notes (meetings + PDFs + YouTube) without a bot requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: No meeting bot auto-join — capture is device recording or file upload (polarising vs Fireflies bot UX)

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: No meeting bot auto-join — capture is device recording or file upload (polarising vs Fireflies bot UX)

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Conversation intelligence / team analytics depth is lighter than Fireflies Business

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Pro transcription minutes (1,200/mo) and session length (120 min) can cap heavy meeting days

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Teams admin/SSO depth needs confirmation versus enterprise meeting suites

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not a general LLM assistant or voice studio

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs HyNote on identical constraints.
